newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan temperatures to be higher than normal.
newsitem.headline: Japan temperatures to be higher than normal.

text.p: Average temperatures in Japan are expected to be higher than average in northern, eastern and western Japan during March 8 to April 7, the Meteorological Agency said on Friday.
In its regular monthly weather report, the agency said that average temperatures were likely to be about the same as the usual year in the southwestern islands.
Rainfall was expected to be light in the southwestern islands, and about average in other parts of the country.
The southwestern islands will probably see a great deal of of sunshine, while other parts of the country are likely to see about average sunshine, the agency said.
